tools.name: search_providers
tools.description: Search doctors, specialists, procedures, and health conditions across the US directory.

term.description: Doctor name, specialty, health condition, or medical procedure.

location.description: US city and state (for example, 'Austin, TX') or 5-digit ZIP code.

insurances.description: Health insurance plan or carrier name.

newPatients.description: Filter for doctors accepting new patients.

rating.description: Minimum patient star rating from 1 to 5.

zocdocBooking.description: Filter for providers with instant online appointment booking.

zocdocVirtual.description: Filter for providers offering telehealth consultations.

ccDoctor.description: Filter for Castle Connolly Top Doctor honorees.

sort.description: Sort by relevance, distance, or patient rating.

genders.description: Filter by doctor gender: "F" for Female or "M" for Male.
